import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class MaxFlowSolver {
        int n;
        List<int[][]> graph;

        public MaxFlowSolver(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new int[0][3]);
            }
        }

        public void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            List<int[]> uEdges = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(graph.get(u)));
            List<int[]> vEdges = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(graph.get(v)));
            uEdges.add(new int[]{v, cap, vEdges.size()});
            vEdges.add(new int[]{u, 0, uEdges.size() - 1});
            graph.set(u, uEdges.toArray(new int[0][3]));
            graph.set(v, vEdges.toArray(new int[0][3]));
        }

        int[] levels;
        int[] it;

        public void computeLevels(int s) {
            levels = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(levels, -1);
            levels[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            queue.offer(s);
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int v = queue.poll();
                for (int[] edge : graph.get(v)) {
                    int to = edge[0], cap = edge[1], rev = edge[2];
                    if (cap > 0 && levels[to] < 0) {
                        levels[to] = levels[v] + 1;
                        queue.offer(to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        public int sendFlow(int v, int t, int flow) {
            if (v == t) return flow;
            for (; it[v] < graph.get(v).length; it[v]++) {
                int[] edge = graph.get(v)[it[v]];
                int to = edge[0], cap = edge[1], rev = edge[2];
                if (cap > 0 && levels[v] < levels[to]) {
                    int pushed = sendFlow(to, t, Math.min(flow, cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        // Update capacities
                        graph.get(v)[it[v]][1] -= pushed;
                        int[] revEdge = graph.get(to)[rev];
                        revEdge[1] += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int total = 0;
            while (true) {
                computeLevels(s);
                if (levels[t] < 0) return total;
                it = new int[n];
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = sendFlow(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int M = 3;
        int[] A = new int[M];
        int[] B = new int[M];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            A[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            B[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        int initialSum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            initialSum += Math.min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % M]);
        }

        MaxFlowSolver mfSolver = new MaxFlowSolver(2 * M + 2);
        int s = 2 * M;
        int t = 2 * M + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            mfSolver.addEdge(s, i, N);
            mfSolver.addEdge(M + i, t, B[i]);
            mfSolver.addEdge(i, M + i, A[i]);
            mfSolver.addEdge(i, M + ((i - 1 + M) % M), A[i]);
        }

        int maxFlowResult = mfSolver.maxFlow(s, t);
        int res = N - maxFlowResult;

        System.out.println(res + " " + initialSum);
    }
}
